findings.title: Exemplary Enhanced Due Diligence - Exceeds CLC Requirements

source.text: Given the client's employment in financial services and residence in a higher-risk jurisdiction (UAE), the following additional verification checks were conducted: (1) Employer Background Verification - regulatory status verified via DFSA register, (2) Role & Position Analysis - confirmed mid-level with no political exposure, (3) Senior Management & Board PEP Screen - all 5 executives screened, (4) Adverse Media Search - 10-year search across multiple databases.

reference.text: CLC guidance requires firms to identify whether a client is a PEP and apply enhanced due diligence where appropriate. The minimum requirement is PEP database screening.

findings.deviation: This file demonstrates due diligence significantly beyond CLC minimum requirements. While CLC guidance only mandates PEP database screening, this firm conducted four additional enhanced checks: employer regulatory verification, role analysis for political exposure, senior management PEP screening, and comprehensive adverse media searches. This thoroughness is commendable for a client in financial services based in an elevated-risk jurisdiction.
